description: Apollo contact provider for Webority.Email.Outreach over Apollo's REST API: lists the saved contact lists, reads the contacts of one list for import, and records each contact's outreach outcome back in Apollo as a list. Never sends mail through Apollo.

Browser tests against your own ASP.NET Core API with XUnitAssured.Playwright: a fixture that hosts the API on a real port with WebApplicationFactory and serves a built front-end on another, so browser tests run with dotnet test alone — in CI, with real cross-origin rules.
